info.title: ae/release-pipeline
info.description: Release pipeline: GitHub Actions workflows, build scripts and the application description, rendered at build time by the TypeScript module server/render.ts (methods tagged typescript), and the Python 3 scripts in server/scripts that the workflows run (methods tagged command; parameters are command-line arguments by position, the result is the exit status, and files named in the arguments are written). Secrets appear only as names of repository secrets. Environment of the scripts: STORE_APP_ID, STORE_BUILD_TOKEN, STORE_API (default https://ourapps.app), STORE_MODE (none: no store; every target in PIPELINE_TARGETS reads as on), PIPELINE_TARGETS, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GH_TOKEN, WEB_URL, WEB_ZIP, TESTFLIGHT_URL, PLATFORM_PACKAGES_JSON, GITHUB_OUTPUT. The scripts read the store's switches from GET <STORE_API>/api/build/<STORE_APP_ID>/targets with a bearer token.

methods.name: renderRelease
methods.description: Renders release/app.json and, by target, release.yml (version, android, web, ios, testflight and publish jobs on every tag, each reading its store switch first), ci-web.yml, ci-android.yml, ci-server.yml (with serverDirectory), platform-packages.yml (unsigned Mac, Apple TV and Windows evidence), apple-testflight.yml, and the Windows and Apple build scripts.

methods.name: writeRelease
methods.description: Writes each file under directory, creating folders, and marks the executable ones 0755. Throws the file system's error when a write fails.

methods.name: validateSettings
methods.description: Checks the settings and which secret references each target needs.

methods.name: parseTargets
methods.description: The targets named, in the order ios, android, web, macos, windows, tvos; unknown, repeated or no targets are errors.

methods.name: secretName
methods.description: The repository secret name for a reference: upper case, runs of other characters as one underscore, no leading or trailing underscore.

methods.name: release_plan.py
methods.description: What one run of the release workflow builds, from release.json (rendered at install from the settings): version and build, the pushed tag, the targets built, one true or false per named target, the store address, and the repository secret name prefix of each reference (store, android_secret, web_secret, hosting_secret; empty for none). Written to GITHUB_OUTPUT when set, and printed.

items.description: <target>=<path>: the file whose presence shows the application has that target's project.

methods.name: release_targets.py read
methods.description: Writes the store's switches (TargetSwitches) to out; with --github-output also writes each as true or false to GITHUB_OUTPUT.

methods.name: release_targets.py check
methods.description: Writes on=true or on=false for the target to GITHUB_OUTPUT.

methods.name: release_targets.py require
methods.description: Fails unless the target is switched on.

methods.name: release_targets.py merge
methods.description: Writes the application manifest for the release: a switched-off target keeps the previous release's install entry (or none; null for pwa, android and ios), and Windows keeps the previous entry when this release brings no Windows package. A path of - reads as an empty object.

methods.name: release_targets.py packages
methods.description: Writes the verified direct packages whose platform is switched on.

methods.name: release_targets.py publishes
methods.description: Exit 0 when this release builds ios, android or web switched on, or brings a switched-on package; else exit 3.

methods.name: app_manifest.py build
methods.description: Writes the validated application manifest (ApplicationManifest) from app.json (AppDescription) and the release inputs {version, iconUrl, apkUrl, webUrl, testflightUrl, screenshots, screenshotsByPlatform}.

methods.name: app_manifest.py validate
methods.description: Applies the store's manifest checks.

methods.name: platform_manifest.py validate
methods.description: Checks each verified Mac or Windows package record against its metadata (format, version, file name, sha256, size) and writes the verified records.

methods.name: platform_manifest.py entries
methods.description: Writes the install entries (DirectPackage per platform) for the application manifest.

methods.name: platform_artifacts.py inspect-apple
methods.description: Reads an Xcode archive's application (architectures, versions, bundle identifier, platform, resources, signature) and writes the evidence.

methods.name: platform_artifacts.py check-export
methods.description: Refuses an export that is not a local App Store Connect export signed for this team and profile.

methods.name: platform_artifacts.py installer-certificate
methods.description: Checks a Mac installer certificate belongs to the team.

methods.name: platform_artifacts.py record-package
methods.description: Writes the verified record of a Mac package from its metadata.

methods.name: platform_artifacts.py record-windows
methods.description: Copies the unsigned Windows installer and writes its evidence after reading the executable header.

methods.name: publish_release.py
methods.description: Creates a GitHub Release with the icon, screenshots, changelog, APK (<application id>.apk), web bundle and my-app.json; reads the store's switches before writing and again before the manifest goes up; a switched-off target keeps the latest release's entry; a failed read leaves GitHub untouched. Exit 0 with nothing published when no target is switched on.

schema.description: The release's tag; default release-<version>-<build>. An existing tag (the pushed v1.2.3) is used as it is.

items.description: A file uploaded to the release and not declared in my-app.json, for example an unsigned Windows installer.

schema.description: 0 on success or when nothing is published.

targets.description: Any of ios, android, web, macos, windows, tvos, lower case, separated by spaces, each at most once, at least one.

storeAddress.description: The store's address with no path (default https://ourapps.app); https, or http only for localhost and 127.0.0.1. A trailing slash is dropped.

manifestUrl.description: Where the store reads my-app.json: the repository's latest release. Unset, empty or none: not given.

repository.description: The application's repository. Unset, empty or none: not given.

storeCredentials.description: Reference name (not secret): repository secrets <NAME>_APP_ID and <NAME>_BUILD_TOKEN. Unset, empty or none: no store call, no iOS job and no Apple TestFlight workflow; every built target is on and the release still publishes to GitHub.

bundleIdentifier.description: Apple bundle identifier; required when targets include ios, macos or tvos.

androidSigning.description: Reference name (not secret): <NAME>_KEYSTORE_BASE64, _KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, _KEY_ALIAS, _KEY_PASSWORD. Required when targets include android.

webDeploy.description: Reference name (not secret) for hosting the web build on Cloudflare: <NAME>_API_TOKEN and <NAME>_ACCOUNT_ID; only with the web target. Unset: the web build is bundled as web.zip.

hostingAccount.description: Reference name (not secret) for the Cloudflare account the server deploys to: <NAME>_API_TOKEN and <NAME>_ACCOUNT_ID. Unset, empty or none: the release deploys no server.

ReleaseSettings.description: The reference names that are set must give different secret names; none means unset.

scriptsDirectory.description: Where the shipped scripts are installed in the application repository; defaults to components/ourapps-release/server/scripts.

appleHelpers.description: Where the Apple signing helpers live (not shipped here); defaults to scripts.

serverDirectory.description: Adds the server check workflow when given.

description.description: Store description, 1 to 300 characters; defaults to applicationName.

extra.description: Fields copied into the application manifest as they are, for example { minPlayers: 2, maxPlayers: 9 }.

signingPrefix.description: Prefix of the environment variables carrying signing values; equals the Android and Apple hosts' prefix. Defaults to the last word of the bundle or application id in capitals.

productName.description: Windows executable name without .exe; defaults to applicationName.

targets.description: In the order ios, android, web, macos, windows, tvos.

files.description: Output path relative to the application repository to file text. Possible paths: release/app.json (always), .github/workflows/release.yml, ci-web.yml, ci-android.yml, ci-server.yml, platform-packages.yml, apple-testflight.yml, scripts/build-apple-testflight.sh, scripts/build-windows.sh, scripts/inspect-windows.ps1.

notes.description: Things the rendered files call that this package does not ship, and files not rendered and why.

AppDescription.description: release/app.json: the application description the publish step reads.

TargetSwitches.description: The store's per-target switches, limited to PIPELINE_TARGETS when set.

ApplicationManifest.description: my-app.json schema 1, as app_manifest.py build writes and validate accepts. Fields of app.json extra appear at the top level.

install.description: At least one entry is not null.

DirectPackage.description: A verified Mac (format dmg, with notarization) or Windows (format exe, without notarization) package entry.

notarization.description: Mac only; an unsigned package is not-notarized.

data.description: Names the setting, option or template problem.

CommandFailed.message: The command exits with status 1 and prints the reason on standard error

data.description: The reason line, prefixed with the script name.

NothingSwitchedOn.message: Nothing in this release is switched on in the store (exit status 3); nothing is published
